notes.title: Patch Notes: 1.0.6
notes.content:
-More gold is now given per round and towers are slightly less powerful now
-There is now a 10 second grace period to place towers before the game starts
-Animations for the towers should now be much smoother
-Ship speeds have been reduced
-Normal map's evnironment has many more interactive elements inside
-New maps now unlock on 2500 and 5000 lifetime pirate kills
-Build menus are now much bigger to enable easier tower placement
-Tower rotations should now be much smoother
